name: get_account
description: Account balance, how many instances this account may run at once, and how many are running now.

name: list_gpus
description: GPU models you can rent, with VRAM per card.

arguments.name: min_vram_gb
arguments.desc: Only GPUs with at least this much VRAM per card

arguments.name: gpu_model
arguments.desc: Filter by model name

name: list_templates
description: Ready-made instance images (for example JupyterLab, Ollama, ComfyUI, LLaMA-Factory) and the GPU each recommends. Templates with has_api_endpoint get a public HTTPS api_url.

name: estimate_cost
description: Quote a GPU rental for a model and a number of hours. Returns a quote_id that create_instance needs. Show the quote to the user and get an explicit yes before renting.

arguments.name: gpu_model
arguments.desc: GPU model exactly as list_gpus returns it

arguments.name: gpu_count
arguments.desc: Number of GPUs, from 1 to 8. Defaults to 1

arguments.name: hours
arguments.desc: Expected run time in hours

arguments.name: template
arguments.desc: Template id from list_templates. Omit for a plain GPU with Python and CUDA

name: list_models
description: Models on CloudGPU's OpenAI-compatible API, using the same key. Use this when you only need inference and do not need to rent a GPU.

name: get_status
description: Status (creating, running, stopped, or failed), minutes run, whether SSH is ready, the public api_url if the template has one, and the auto-shutdown limits.

arguments.name: instance_id
arguments.desc: Id of the instance

name: list_instances
description: Instances on this account: running, starting, and those stopped in the last 7 days.

name: create_instance
description: Rents the GPU from a quote. Requires a quote_id from estimate_cost that the user has approved. max_spend_usd and max_hours are enforced by CloudGPU: the instance is destroyed when either is reached, even if this assistant has disconnected. idle_minutes destroys it after the GPU sits idle that long (installing packages and downloading data count as idle, so allow for setup).

arguments.name: quote_id
arguments.desc: quote_id returned by estimate_cost

arguments.name: user_confirmed
arguments.desc: True only if the user explicitly approved this quote in the conversation

arguments.name: max_spend_usd
arguments.desc: Spend ceiling for this instance, at most the CLOUDGPU_MAX_SPEND_USD cap

arguments.name: max_hours
arguments.desc: Hard time limit in hours, at most the CLOUDGPU_MAX_HOURS cap

arguments.name: idle_minutes
arguments.desc: Destroy after the GPU has been idle this long. 0 turns the idle limit off; otherwise at least 10. Defaults to 60

name: run_command
description: Runs a bash command on the instance as root, in an interactive-style shell so conda and venv setup from ~/.bashrc are active. Foreground returns the exit code and the last 20k characters of output. For anything longer than a few minutes, such as training or large downloads, use background=true, then tail_logs.

arguments.name: instance_id
arguments.desc: Id of the instance

arguments.name: command
arguments.desc: Bash command or script

arguments.name: background
arguments.desc: Run in the background. Defaults to false

arguments.name: timeout_sec
arguments.desc: Foreground timeout in seconds, from 5 to 3600. Defaults to 600

arguments.name: workdir
arguments.desc: Directory to run in. Defaults to ~

annotations.title: Run a command on the instance

name: upload
description: Copies a local file or directory (this computer) to the instance over SFTP. node_modules, .git, and __pycache__ are skipped. Credential files (.ssh, .env, keys) are refused unless allow_sensitive is true and the user asked for it.

arguments.name: instance_id
arguments.desc: Id of the instance

arguments.name: local_path
arguments.desc: Local file or directory on this computer

arguments.name: remote_path
arguments.desc: Destination on the instance, for example /root/project or /root/data/

arguments.name: allow_sensitive
arguments.desc: Allow credential files such as .ssh, .env, or keys. Defaults to false. Only when the user asked for it

name: download
description: Copies a file or directory from the instance to this computer. Do this for every result before stop_instance: destroying an instance erases its disk.

arguments.name: instance_id
arguments.desc: Id of the instance

arguments.name: remote_path
arguments.desc: File or directory on the instance

arguments.name: local_path
arguments.desc: Local destination file or directory, for example ./outputs/

name: tail_logs
description: Last lines of a background job's log (job_id) or any log file (path), whether the job is still running and its exit code, plus current GPU utilisation and memory.

arguments.name: instance_id
arguments.desc: Id of the instance

arguments.name: job_id
arguments.desc: Job id from run_command with background=true

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Log file path on the instance

arguments.name: lines
arguments.desc: Number of log lines, from 1 to 2000. Defaults to 100

name: stop_instance
description: Destroys the instance and ends the rental. Its disk is erased. If commands were run on it in this session and nothing was downloaded, this refuses unless force=true, and only after the user confirms the results are not needed.

arguments.name: instance_id
arguments.desc: Id of the instance

arguments.name: force
arguments.desc: Destroy even if results have not been downloaded. Defaults to false
